highlights: Every tenant-wide role now states that it applies to all organizations — on the invite screen, in the role-change dialog and in the superadmin area — with the organization count shown when you invite, and a short confirmation the first time you grant one

People pickers, permission overviews, sharing lists, naming prefixes and group details now follow the organization you are working in, while your own access stays visible and Tenant-Admins keep the full picture
Every new version must now pass a dedicated organization-boundary check before it is shipped, to the test environment or to production
